mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals stronger earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained quarterly GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals tightening monetary policy, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5%

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly growth in GDP (GDPC1) and demand (HOUST) signals robust economic expansion, amplifying investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime marked by high industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1), S&P 500 forward returns exhibit heightened sensitivity to these leading indicators, producing positive returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive in late-cycle expansion regime despite high INDPRO and GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate below 4% signals labor market strengthening, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite UNRATE falling below 4.0%

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects stronger supply-side activity, enhancing corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive despite sustained INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) combined with rising GDP growth (GDPC1) signal accommodative monetary policy and expanding demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in employment (PAYEMS > 5000) exceeding 5 million indicates a robust labor market, stimulating consumer demand and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive despite employment exceeding 5 million.
